notes: Shopify store, reached entirely via the Chrome connector tab (no proxy/curl route needed - site loaded normally, robots.txt has no Claude-specific Disallow, only a general User-agent:* block plus bot-specific entries for AhrefsBot/adsbot-google/Nutch/ChatGPT-User/MJ12bot/Pinterest). ellementry is primarily a tableware/decor brand (prior Home Decor pass covered Kitchen & Dining, Decorative Accessories, Wall Decor, Lighting, Mirrors, Clocks) but it also carries a small 'accent furniture' side assortment reachable from the top-nav 'FURNITURE & LIGHTING' link (/collections/furniture-lighting, a mixed furniture+lighting grouping page, 96 items). Because that nav item mixes two departments with no visible furniture-only subnav, I built the tree from the Shopify collections index (/collections.json, 472 total collections) filtered for furniture-type keywords, then verified each candidate via same-origin fetch of /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 (every collection here is well under 250 items, so this is a full, untruncated distinct-product-ID enumeration - the same method the prior Home Decor pass validated for this site). Corroborated once against the rendered page: /collections/coffee-table showed 'Coffee Table ... 12 Results' matching the products.json count of 12 exactly, so the two sources agree and products.json was trusted for the rest. Sanity-checked every leaf by reading product titles (not just counting) to rule out cross-tagged non-furniture items and confirmed each URL's own SEO <title> is unique/specific (not a generic parent title), showing these are genuine standalone nodes rather than 404s silently serving a parent listing. EXCLUDED as out of scope or non-canonical: all Lighting (pendant-lamp, table-lamp, floor-lamp), Mirrors, Clocks, Kitchen & Dining, Decorative Accessories, textiles/tableware/kitchenware (already catalogued as non-furniture by the prior Home Decor pass); 'furniture' handle (30 items) - a curated homepage collection smaller than the union of the real product-type collections below and overlapping several of them, treated as a marketing 'Collection' per scope rule 3, not a taxonomic parent; 'furniture-accent', 'furniture-accent-table', 'furniture-accent-bench' - curated 'Accent Pieces' spotlight collections whose items are a strict subset already counted under Bench/Tables; 'furniture-accessories' (0 products; its only description on the furniture-lighting page is door/drawer 'Knobs', which is excluded furniture hardware even when populated); 'bedroom-side-table' (identical 8-item product set to Side Table - exact duplicate alias); 'dining-room-table' (single item, a subset already inside Dining Table's own 4); 'breakfast-table-1' (exact duplicate of Breakfast Table's single item); 'barware-trolley' (exact duplicate of Trolley's 2 items); 'living-room-table' (3 items, but 2 of the 3 are NOT tables - one is a ceramic pasta bowl and one is a chair - the collection's own tagging is too unreliable to trust as a furniture node). KEPT despite overlap, because each is a genuinely separate, independently-reachable listing page with its own dedicated SEO title (verified via <title> tag): 'Seating' (17 items) overlaps heavily with Bench/Dining Chair/Ottoman (same products cross-tagged into multiple site collections) - flagged. 'Living Room Chair' (3 items) includes 1 non-chair item ('Farmhouse flair ready-to-assemble pub table') per the site's own tagging - flagged; qty is still the site's exact reported count. 'Bar Cabinet' has 0 products but is a live, correctly-routed node (breadcrumb 'Home > bar cabinet', own SEO title, genuine 'NO PRODUCTS FOUND' empty state, not a redirect to a parent) - emitted per the live-0-count rule. No parent/child nav structure was found beyond the single mixed 'Furniture & Lighting' top-nav link, so no grouping rows are emitted - all rows below are leaves directly under top bucket 'Furniture'.
